summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Aon plc on June 26, 2026, primarily reporting the results of its annual general meeting of shareholders, including the election of directors, ratification of the independent auditor, approval of executive compensation on an advisory basis, and other customary proposals. The filing also discloses the departure of certain directors and the appointment of new directors, along with compensatory arrangements. No unusual or special-situation events such as mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, tender offers, going-private transactions, or restructuring are described. The filing is a standard current report related to governance and shareholder votes, not a special situation.
